<includeonly><div style="position: relative; width: 80px;"><div style="position: absolute; left: 0px; top: 0px; padding: 0;">[[File:{{{sparkle}}}|{{{sparkle_size}}}]]</div>{{{icon}}}</div></includeonly><noinclude>
== Template:SparkleIcon ==

Displays an item icon with an optional sparkle overlay for quality tiers.

=== Parameters ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Parameter !! Required !! Default !! Description
|-
| '''icon''' || Yes || || The item icon (full <nowiki>[[File:...]]</nowiki> syntax)
|-
| '''sparkle''' || Yes || || Sparkle overlay image filename (Blue_Sparkle.gif, Purple_Sparkle.gif, or blank.png)
|-
| '''sparkle_size''' || Yes || || Size of the sparkle overlay (e.g., 80px)
|}

=== Examples ===

'''Normal item (no sparkle - use blank.png):'''
<pre>
{{SparkleIcon
|icon=[[File:Copper_Sword.png|80px]]
|sparkle=blank.png
|sparkle_size=0px
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{SparkleIcon
|icon=[[File:Copper_Sword.png|80px]]
|sparkle=blank.png
|sparkle_size=0px
}}

----

'''Blessed item (blue sparkle):'''
<pre>
{{SparkleIcon
|icon=[[File:Copper_Sword.png|80px]]
|sparkle=Blue_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{SparkleIcon
|icon=[[File:Copper_Sword.png|80px]]
|sparkle=Blue_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}

----

'''Godly item (purple sparkle):'''
<pre>
{{SparkleIcon
|icon=[[File:Copper_Sword.png|80px]]
|sparkle=Purple_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}
</pre>

'''Result:'''

{{SparkleIcon
|icon=[[File:Copper_Sword.png|80px]]
|sparkle=Purple_Sparkle.gif
|sparkle_size=80px
}}
